definition: fall = the q-quantile of L_h(t) = 1 - min{P(s): t < s <= t+h} / P(t) over check times t: the largest fall a later check or sale inside the horizon can see, exceeded after a check at a random moment with estimated probability at most 1 - q.
rule: fall = min(1, max(0, empirical quantile (numpy 'higher'), GPD quantile)), rounded up to 4 decimals. GPD: maximum likelihood on excesses of -ln(1-L) over its 95th percentile (0 if that is negative); at least 30 excesses or the tail is recorded as not identifiable.
loadRule: Owner's rule of 2026-11-22 as applied in DEVIATIONS.md D2: an entry is 'calibrated' and load = true only if walk-forward validation is not rejected at q = 0.999 or 0.9999 and the tail is identifiable (and, for USDT/INR, the D1 settlement test passes). Every other entry is 'illustrative', load = false and carries no termDef: the wallet keeps its illustrative value. Never load an entry with load = false.
walletNote: valuation.ts line 134 treats only status 'verified' as non-illustrative. A termDef here has status 'calibrated'; the loader (or that line) must treat 'calibrated' as non-illustrative and show termDef.source, which carries the owner's wording and the stress exceedances.
